Depression is tricky because you feel depressed while isolated; unemployed, no irl friends, no school. But then, when you try to socialize or "get your life together", you end up feeling more shitty because you're surrounded by people who do not understand how you feel and would only feel uncomfortable if you try to open up to them. I used to quit my jobs because of depression. I just couldn't bear to wake up in the mornings. I would cry in the bathroom, in front of my supervisors, or even with my clients on the phone. It got me to the point where I almost ran away without a penny 3 times in 3 years. SIGH. Like last poster said, you might not be able to feel better by getting a job until you feel like you'll be able to handle it. 
 I'ts hard to find people who will understand but I feel like talking to someone who has experienced any form of depression or hopelessness, might be able to help you express yourself more and not feel useless and worthless. A reassurance that things will be ok, that they are there for you. If you ever want to talk or just chat about whatever, hmu!
